name: html-to-figma
description: Render HTML in headless Chromium and generate a Figma plugin script that rebuilds it as Figma components (flexbox → Auto Layout, real text, fills, shadows, images, SVG).

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: node bin/html-to-figma.js examples/pricing-card.html -o out && node test/mock-figma-run.js out/figma-script.js && node test/mock-figma-run.js out/figma-plugin/code.js
scripts.preview: node bin/html-to-figma.js examples/pricing-card.html -o out && node test/preview.js out/figma-script.js examples/pricing-card.html out/preview.html
